<function name="CrosshairDisable" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Disables the default player's crosshair. Can be reenabled with <page>Player:CrosshairEnable</page>. This will affect <page>WEAPON:DoDrawCrosshair</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Disables crosshair of the first player on the server.</description>
	<code>Entity( 1 ):CrosshairDisable()</code>

</example>
